notes: Variable frequency drive point dictionary. The VFD family's rules are application-agnostic (fan, pump); the process-variable pair is deliberately untyped beyond 'the controlled variable in its own units' and marked provisional. Owning equipment: brick:Variable_Frequency_Drive (verified in Brick 1.4.4).

points.name: vfd_speed_cmd

s223.pattern: QuantifiableActuatableProperty on the VFD via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Speed_Setpoint grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4 (the commanded speed the drive is asked to track).

points.name: vfd_speed

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty on the driven motor via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Motor_Speed_Sensor grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4; brick:Speed_Status is the drive-reported alternative — bind whichever the site trends, but note VFD-0001 diagnosis 5 (tachometer failure) argues for the drive-reported value where both exist.

points.name: vfd_process_value
points.description: Controlled process variable (pressure, flow, or temperature — the loop's PV, in its own units)
points.notes: Deliberately generic: the VFD family's rules compare PV against setpoint in whatever unit the loop uses, and VFD-0002's pv_error_threshold is set in those same units. Semantic tags belong on the application-specific point (duct static pressure, water differential pressure, ...) that the host binds here.

points.name: vfd_process_sp
points.description: Setpoint for the controlled process variable (same units as vfd_process_value)
points.notes: See vfd_process_value; the pair must be bound from the same loop in the same units.
